name: omgadrian (Cinematic Story)
inspired_by: omgadrian (2 reels measured; add more refs to tighten the numbers)
summary: Cinematic story: huge condensed yellow titles paired with a small italic serif lead-in, tiny serif subtitles, B-roll-led cutting every ~2 s, warm filmic grade with lifted blacks and occasional B&W.

title.capcut_hint: a heavy condensed sans (Anton / Bebas Neue / Oswald Bold)

big_word.rule: 1–3 words only, the beat of the line ('BETTER', 'FIX THAT', 'FOREVER')

grade.notes: Lifted blacks, warm highlights (measured highlight tint R+0.03 / B-0.12), muted greens. B&W for reflective lines.

punch_in.on: none; movement comes from B-roll and camera moves

animations.cards: photos / screenshots as floating cards on a dark grid or light paper background, slow drift

music.mood: cinematic lo-fi / warm beat; switch track at the big turn

not_possible_in_capcut: 3D rotating thumbnail carousel (After Effects) → use a flat card slideshow
Video-inside-letters knockout text → use the big yellow title over darkened footage
Stop-motion paper cut-outs → skip or use a photo card
